messages:
maria (ML Eng): Intake: proposing to onboard 'velvet-qa-7b-v2' for QA/search assistant experiments. Repo: https://github.com/upstream/velvet-qa. License attached looks custom (see snippet). Need legal + export + hosting clearance before any hosted API exposure. Planning canary on Dedicated if green.
kevin (Legal): please paste the license text and any CLA / contributor docs. quick Q: is there an explicit non-commercial or redistribution restriction? that will block hosted.
maria (ML Eng): pasted license snippet:
```
Copyright 2025 Upstream AI
Redistribution and derivative works are permitted for research and personal use only. Commercial use prohibited without separate license.
```
Also tokenizer uses third-party vocab from a closed dataset (mentions vendor X).
license-bot: Automated scan result: potential license restriction detected — "Commercial use prohibited" clause found. Third-party dataset references flagged for review.
olivia (ML Ops): intended product usage? Hosted API (public customers) or private/dedicated only?
maria (ML Eng): primary goal was hosted for our freemium QA endpoint. We were going to run quantization experiments (4-bit) to reduce cost next sprint.
kevin (Legal): NC clause (non-commercial) means we cannot offer this via hosted API or include in any customer-facing paid plan. Also unclear whether quantization counts as a derivative — typically it does (transforming weights). we need explicit permission to redistribute modified/quantized weights commercially.
samir (Product): ouch. timeline impact — negotiating license could add weeks. Alternatives: (1) ask upstream for commercial license, (2) pick alternate model from our open catalog, (3) only allow this model on Private/Dedicated where customers bring their own consent/contract. Thoughts?
liz (Security): also need dataset provenance check. closed vendor vocab + unknown training sources -> risk of PII or licensed data. Data team must validate and produce a model card entry before any evals that could leak content.
maria (ML Eng): can we at least run local evals and quantization in our private infra to measure quality? not exposing it publicly yet.
kevin (Legal): Internal evaluation for research only is usually OK under NC clauses, but we must not persist or share derived weights externally. If you plan to quantize and store a new artifact, tag as "internal-research" and restrict access. If you later want to use it commercially, we need a license grant.
devex: Suggest creating a model-gate ticket with the following fields: name, repo link, license snippet, dataset notes, intended usage (hosted/dedicated/private), quantization intent, owner, target rollout. Example command to create ticket:
```
# model-gate create \
  --name velvet-qa-7b-v2 \
  --repo https://github.com/upstream/velvet-qa \
  --license-file LICENSE.txt \
  --usage hosted:dont,private:ok \
  --owner @maria
```
Also: add label "license:NC" and "data:needs-provenance".
kevin (Legal): action plan: legal to draft outreach to Upstream for a commercial license or a commercial carve-out (7–14 day ETA). maria please open the ticket and include exact license text and the contact info you used. if no response in 7 days, block hosted onboarding.
maria (ML Eng): will open ticket and email upstream today (link to thread will be in ticket). I'll run isolated quant evals in the private infra under restricted ACLs.
olivia (ML Ops): note: Dedicated deployment policy allows customer-owned content only. we can only enable Dedicated if customer signs off. For Hosted we need explicit redistribution/derivative rights.
license-bot: Status update: label applied (action_required: license-negotiation).
kevin (Legal): also check export control: model architecture uses encryption libs and may be flagged for certain embargoed countries. liz, can you triage export control with infra?
liz (Security): on it — I'll run an export-control checklist and ping infra. expecting short follow-up.
samir (Product): prioritization: gating this until license clarified. Marking as P2 for product; if upstream grants commercial license quickly we can slot for next canary.
maria (ML Eng): thanks — will post ticket number once created and CC legal.
kevin (Legal): agreed. if upstream refuses, we should add a note to the model catalog to avoid accidental selection.
maria (ML Eng): noted :thumbsup:"
